name: object_contact_v5
changed_factors: decoded-point admission uses half max aperture plus finger clearance in the same-frame image-metric ellipse
blocker recovery uses a low-tilt 15, 30, 45 degree ladder
blocker recovery requires both world-down and camera-ray hypotheses to execute and fail on measured non-target obstructions

prompt: Point to visible grasp contact locations on the {noun} at the tail, or start, of the green arrow. Ignore the arrowhead and destination.
